name: aocc-cookbook
description: Cosmos CMS plugin marketplace for GitHub repository

plugins.name: F2E2-eysoos-icons
plugins.description: @eysoos/icons SVG 圖標庫 — ASUS CMS 設計系統圖示元件

plugins.name: F2E2-eysoos-ui-v2
plugins.description: @eysoos/prisma React UI 元件庫（第二代）— ASUS CMS 設計系統元件

plugins.name: F2E2-eysoos-ui-v2-reference-doc
plugins.description: 產生或更新 @eysoos/prisma 元件的 reference markdown 文件

plugins.name: F2E2-jira-ticket-scan
plugins.description: 掃描並摘要 Jira 每日更新，用於 daily-standup 和進度回報

plugins.name: F2E2-cosmos-new-page-scaffolder
plugins.description: Automated scaffolding expert for new pages in the Cosmos monorepo. Streamlines the creation of new page structures, ensuring consistency and adherence to best practices across the codebase.

plugins.name: F2E2-cosmos-test
plugins.description: Greet the user with random creative content within 10 words.

plugins.name: F2E2-agent-handoff-schema
plugins.description: Shared handoff envelope shell used by every agent in the handoff pipeline (data-gathering, planning, coding-agent, ...)

plugins.name: F2E2-handoff-sync-in
plugins.description: Pull the shared agent-handoff folder (.claude/handoff/) from the per-issue handoff branch into the runner working tree, read-only

plugins.name: F2E2-handoff-sync-out
plugins.description: Write an agent's owned handoff/session files back to the per-issue handoff branch, from an isolated worktree

plugins.name: F2E2-log-keeper
plugins.description: Write or update a session log entry under .claude/log/sessions/, best-effort mirrored to Elasticsearch

plugins.name: F2E2-planning-template
plugins.description: Plan document template for the planning agent's Design phase

plugins.name: F2E2-planning-agent
plugins.description: Cloud planning agent — pulls the data-gathering handoff, validates it, drafts an implementation plan for human review, and writes the planning handoff back to the branch
